" ++ "Status : FAILED - PROCESSING ABORTED
" ++ "--------------------------------------------
" ++ row("Environment", upper(payload.env)) ++ row("Trace ID", payload.traceId) ++ row("Timestamp", payload.timestamp) ++ "
" ++ row("Error Type", payload.errorType) ++ row("Error Message", payload.errorMessage) ++ "--------------------------------------------

" ++ "Action Required: The batch did not complete. Please check the application logs using the Trace ID above and reprocess the file once the issue is resolved.

" ++ "Regards,
PRC Inventory Batch API
" ++ "(Automated message. Please do not reply.)"
